Training Doc Auditor

Check training docs still match the live system.
SKILL · RUNS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN IT APPLIES

What it does

Systematically cross-checks the training docs against the registry and handoff files to catch accumulated drift between what the docs say and what agents actually do.

Three layers, not just the prose

  • The agent registry - versions, statuses, deployment targets, renames and retirements.
  • Handoff and blueprint files - what each agent was actually built to do.
  • The hub card index - the card entries themselves: whether every card resolves to a file that exists, whether a card is defined but unreachable from any audience tab, and whether a served doc has no card at all. Drift here is invisible in the docs, because the document reads fine while nobody can find it.

It can apply the fixes

Findings are not just reported. On your approval it applies the corrections directly, rather than handing back a list to re-key by hand. You see what it intends to change before it changes anything.

When to use it

Triggers are event-based, not calendar-based: after deploying a new agent or a major version, after a rename or retirement, and before onboarding staff onto the docs. There is no fixed audit cadence - running it on a schedule when nothing has changed finds nothing, and waiting for the schedule after something has changed is how the drift accumulates in the first place.

How to trigger it

"audit training docs"

"are the training materials up to date"

"training doc audit"

Requirements

What this skill needs in order to run. Added 2026-08-20.

Skills - None.

Connectors / MCP servers - None.

Folder access - Read access to the hub's served docs and card data, and to the agent registry it audits against.

KB modules / context files - context-agent-registry.md.

Repos - None.

If something is missing - A missing registry is LOUD. The SILENT failure is a scan that reads a smaller set than the hub actually serves and returns a clean result for documents it never opened - which is exactly what happened before the scan root was repointed at the served set. Confirm what was scanned, not just the verdict.
